samples_manifest.description: S3 URI to a TSV manifest with columns tumor_sample, normal_sample

reads_dir.description: S3 URI prefix containing per-sample paired-end FASTQ files named {sample}_R1.fastq / {sample}_R2.fastq

reference.description: S3 URI to the reference FASTA (panel or genome) used for alignment and variant calling

gene_model.description: S3 URI to a TSV gene/hotspot model used for panel annotation

outdir.description: Output location for results (HealthOmics stages this to the run's output S3 location)
